text_block_list.text: I invited Trainer Kiryuin out to the park for a break from our daily routine, and when we arrived—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Coming to the park without it being related to work... it feels like it's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...When I was a kid, I used to come play here all the time, even by myself.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I-I had friends, you know? But, um... I just also enjoyed playing alone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
For instance, sitting atop the jungle gym staring at the sky,
reading Monthly Twinkle……

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Sitting on the swing,
reading through the 'Trainer White Paper'...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I was simply enjoying various things.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! That's just one of my favorite stories,
I definitely played on the playground equipment too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Like on the seesaw, or the horizontal bar!
choice_data_list: On a seesaw all by yourself...?
Do you have any favorite tricks on the horizontal bar?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As an adult, it's not really
something I can teach the kids, though...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You walk from one end of the seesaw to the other. It's surprisingly great for training your sense of balance!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: The trick is to lower your stance only when crossing to the other side, but――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to sharpen your senses,
you should constantly maintain proper posture.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, shall I demonstrate for you!
Keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hup. Avoid where you sit down...
Straighten the spine, and keep it level...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Look, right here.
This is where it suddenly jerks, but—

Balancing with both arms outstretched, Kiryuin made it all the way across the seesaw.
...Looking quite proud of herself.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
How was that? I've always been quite confident
in my sense of balance, and my friends praised me for it...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. S-Sorry for babbling on like that.
choice_data_list: I'll give it a try too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ! Why, of course! I'll be right beside you providing backup, so don't you worry.

After making sure there were no kids around,
Trainer Kiryuin and I played on the seesaw.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes, pull-ups!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The trick is not to overdo it right away,
but to ease into it gradually according to your ability.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: At first, ten reps... or even five reps is fine.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Results are what matters most. That does not mean
one should disregard the process, however.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because the proper process is followed
that one can achieve results—
choice_data_list: Isn't that training rather than just playing around?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I-If that's the case... does that mean I've never actually played at a park before...?

Noticing Trainer Kiryuin's stunned expression as
she realized the shocking truth, I invited her to
play on the swings together.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't do much at first, but I gradually got used to it, and ended up doing around 100 reps!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I haven't done that lately.
Do you mind if I try it out?

I cheered on Trainer Kiryuin,
who was doing pull-ups with total focus and determination.
